newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers stable, Med prices soften.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers stable, Med prices soften.

text.p: ARA bunkers were steady again on Thursday, but bunker prices in many other European ports weakened in a thin end to the week, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst fuel oil stayed in the range $125-$126 fob, as the barge market barely strayed from Thursday's traded levels.
Traders said the ARA market proved relatively busy for a Friday. A number of buyers had expected the market to weaken and had deliberately left their purchases until the end of the week.
"It was not bad for a Friday," one trader said.
Hamburg was also stable, with 380 cst fuel oil at around $127 fob. The market was very quiet.

Bunkers in Mediterranean ports mostly weakened. Fuel oil in southern France was down $1 a tonne, and in Spain prices dropped by about $2. Most areas only managed a small amount of pre-weekend business.
"A lot of buyers are playing the waiting game again. There's a feeling the prices will go down again," said one Mediterranean supplier.
